free_tier.stated: 256 GB / 512 GB / 1 TB / 2 TB / 3 TB / 4 TB / 8 TB / 16 TB. 16 TB is the ceiling on a single VPS; the ladder is flat-priced, so €/TB does not improve above 1 TB.

egress.terms: Metered, not free. Plan transfer allowances: 1 TB plan = 3 TB/mo, 2 TB plan = 6 TB, 4 TB = 10 TB, 8 TB = 20 TB, 16 TB = 40 TB, all on ports 'up to 10 Gbit'. We charge 3.0EUR additional per TB over the allowance, unless otherwise agreed upon.' (https://alphavps.com/terms). The backup-storage landing page separately advertises 'No egress fees, no vendor lock-in' and 'EGRESS €0 - FLAT' — that is marketing copy contradicted and the provider are the binding document. Treat egress as €3/TB metered.

interface_detail: sftp, rsync, nfs, rest (self-hosted: MinIO/SeaweedFS/Nextcloud on the VPS, or WebDAV)
tooling: rclone over SFTP/WebDAV, BorgBackup, Restic, rsync. No native S3 — you host your own gateway.
chaining: Best of the VPS class for the archive half: root KVM, so AList/OpenList or MinIO can be installed and fronted by Cloudflare for cache-covered egress. Not usable as a raw S3 origin without running MinIO.
limits_note: per-object-cap: none (block device). RAID-60 with NVMe read cache. 14-day money-back on FIRST order only, excludes promos, crypto, and orders from China.
reliability_note: Bulgarian operator (DA International Group Ltd.), own AS203380 since 2013, 99.9% uptime SLA in the published SLA. Long-running positive sentiment on LowEndTalk; one 2022 thread documents a bad provisioning experience but not data loss.
